string-array.name: guide_bodies
string-array.item: Che779 runs J2ME games (.jar) on Android in several tabs at once.\n\nThis guide has %1$d pages. Swipe left or tap Next; tap Skip if you already know the app.

• Pick a game from the list.
• The + button on the bottom bar adds a tab and lets you choose its game.
• Tap a tab number to switch.
• The grid button shows many tabs at once.

Tap the three-dot button on the bottom bar:
• Restart tab
• Lock tab
• Proxy, IP redirect
• FPS limit, Power mode, Screen sleep
• Virtual keypad, Key macro
• User guide, Save log

Restart tab: leave empty for the current tab, or enter several: 1-6, 1,3,5 or 1-3,7. Tabs reopen one after another.\n\nLock tab: a locked tab shows a lock icon and cannot be closed or restarted by accident. The menu item becomes Unlock tab when the tab is locked.
In grid mode, turn key sync on to send one key press to several tabs.\n\nEach group has its own colour, e.g. 3 tabs of game A red and 3 of game B blue. Keys only reach tabs in the same group.

The Che779 keypad has 3 styles: Nokia numeric, Android (QWERTY) and Shortcuts.

Shortcuts: tap + to add a button, name it and pick the key sequence. Long-press a button to edit or delete. You can also type into game text fields.

Opacity, key size and background are in Settings.
Record key presses and play them back x1, x10 or forever. A small panel floats on screen; drag it by the handle.\n\nA warning shows on first use: macros in online games may break the game rules.

Settings → Proxy manager:
• Unlimited proxies; import from a file or paste text.
• Filter by HTTP, SOCKS4, SOCKS5.
• Bulk test; Auto mode detects the right type.
• Bulk delete: selected, dead, or everything filtered.

Assign a proxy per tab in the game menu → Proxy.

Turn it on in Settings. A tab reopens when it hangs (an action runs over 45 s) or the game quits unexpectedly.\n\nAt most 5 times in a row per tab to avoid endless loops. A tab that runs stably for over 5 minutes resets the count.

Settings, proxies, macros, shortcuts and the keypad background are kept in the Che779Data folder next to your games, so a reinstall restores them.\n\nUpdates: Settings → Check for updates, tap Open browser to download the latest APK and install it over the old one.
